- [b]Content Patcher [/b](v1.29.1 and up)


The following mod isn't required but highly recommended:

- [b]Generic Mod Config Menu [/b](1.11 and up)


The mod is enabled by default and set to "Extra 1" but you can easily change it through the Generic Mod Config Menu or the config.json file after you launch the game with the mod installed.[/center]
